ex.s: But since the results at 70 decibels were significant, the study also suggests that the right level of background noise—not too loud and not total silence—may actually improve one’s creative thinking ability.
ex.t: 但由于70分贝下的结果具有显著性，该研究也表明，适当的背景噪音水平——不太吵也不完全无声——实际上可能提升一个人的创造性思维能力。
